protocol: One warmup plus five measured iterations, Release, sequential processes
notes: Reader-only runs use the same ClosedXML default graphics engine in both versions; no font rendering occurs.
Full PDF runs register only the same supplied Noto Sans JP file with system fonts and font pack disabled.
recheck-* and report-* runs disable tiered compilation in both versions.
ordinary and shared reader fixtures have equivalent mixed-value contents; report-* uses existing 06-layout-and-pagination.xlsx.
Peak managed memory is sampled at metric callbacks; RSS is the process cumulative peak.
